methods.name: list
methods.description: Every configured agent with its handle, instructions, model route, preset and usage. Read-only.

methods.name: get
methods.description: One agent by `@handle`, or null when no agent has that handle. Read-only.

methods.name: presets
methods.description: The Agent presets this Host can start a thread with, for an agent whose preset decides its tools. Not an agent tool.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Create or update one agent. `tone` is its colour, an identity palette slot 0–5 the active theme paints: null returns it to the default hashed from the handle, and leaving it out keeps the current one. May run only when the user asked for that change.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Remove one agent. Destructive: requires `confirm: true`, which is never implied by a bare request.

methods.name: recordUse
methods.description: Record a dispatch: bump last-used time and count, and keep the thread it opened so the panel can list it after a Host restart. Not an agent tool.

methods.name: threads
methods.description: The threads one agent started, newest first, with their titles and start times. Read-only.

methods.name: threadAgent
methods.description: The agent that started one thread, by Session id, or null for a thread no agent started. Read-only; a cross-plugin lookup, not an agent tool.

methods.name: toolCatalog
methods.description: Every tool this Host serves, grouped by MCP server (mcp:<server>), owning plugin (plugin:<package>) or DSH itself (native), with the first sentence of each description: the keys agents_tool_access_set takes. Read-only.

methods.name: toolAccess
methods.description: One agent's tool access: sparse enabled/pinned entries per tool name and per group; every tool without an entry is enabled and deferred behind tool_search. Null when no agent has that handle. Read-only.

methods.name: setToolAccess
methods.description: Enable, disable, pin or unpin tools or whole groups for one agent; a tool entry beats its group entry. Threads started afterwards get it (a running thread keeps its tools; override it with agents_thread_override_set). Reversible: an edit with entry null removes that entry. May run only when the user asked for that change.

methods.name: setSubagents
methods.description: Which agents this agent's subagents may run as ('any' or a list of handles) and the default one (null: the parent thread's agent). Reversible by setting the previous value. May run only when the user asked for that change.

methods.name: projectDefaults
methods.description: The default agent of each DSH project (by project workspace id). A thread no agent started, in that project, gets it; projects without one use @dsh. Read-only.

methods.name: setProjectDefault
methods.description: Set a DSH project's default agent, or clear it with handle null (threads then use @dsh). Threads started afterwards get it; running threads keep theirs. May run only when the user asked for that change.

methods.name: threadAccess
methods.description: One thread's agent, how it was decided (explicit, inherited from a subagent's parent, the project default or the @dsh fallback), its override and the tool policy that results. recorded: false is a preview for a thread whose agent is not decided yet. Read-only.

methods.name: setThreadOverride
methods.description: Override one thread's tools with another agent's tools ({ kind: 'agent', handle }) or every tool ({ kind: 'all' }); null clears it. It applies from that thread's next model request, which loses its prompt cache once. May run only when the user asked for that change.

methods.name: recordThreadAgent
methods.description: Record a thread's agent explicitly (a subagent started with an agent, a mention) before or after it attaches; null when no agent has that handle. A cross-plugin write, not an agent tool.

methods.name: threadHandles
methods.description: Every remembered thread a configured agent started, with its handle, so thread lists can name the agent. Read-only; agents_threads covers the agent tool.
